title: All Paths From Source to Target - Solution
intuition: Given a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of n nodes labeled from 0 to n - 1, find all possible paths from node 0 to node n - 1 and return them in any order.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
common_mistakes: Use backtracking DFS. Build paths step by step and append to result when target is reached.
